decision.reason: Runtime-backed typed storage is broad, but it separates into HashMap value semantics and Channel scheduler semantics. Direct generic nominal fields are already native, and the application corpus has no user-defined generic storage nominal from which to derive one language-general representation rule.

hashmap.semantic_parent: Able hashing and equality, mutation, aliasing, clone, iteration, insertion identity, and nullable recovery

channel.semantic_parent: ordering, blocking, wakeup, cancellation, close, concurrent payload lifetime, and scheduler bookkeeping

dependency_wave_allocation_control.note: Top-level operation routes are disjoint. Percentages use phase-stats allocation counts rather than pprof serialization totals.

nominal_origin.HashMap: runtime handle plus runtime.Value kernel store
nominal_origin.Channel: runtime handle plus runtime.Value scheduler payload

carrier.application_nominal: native pointer/struct until a runtime service boundary

identity_and_aliasing.direct_nominal: preserved by shared native nominal lowering guards
identity_and_aliasing.Channel: payload must outlive sender and cross goroutines

interface_exposure.HashMap: 11 of 14 executable applications expose generated Map interfaces; three call concrete methods
interface_exposure.Channel: concrete specialized methods enter scheduler helpers

classification.fallback_materialization: All surveyed applications are fallback-free and interpreter-free; observed materialization is required by the current runtime-service ABIs, not compiler fallback.

next.action: Expand the portable suite only with a genuine unlike application/domain whose natural design uses application-defined generic storage, then measure it before reopening representation work.
next.why: The current corpus proves runtime-service cost but contains no application-defined generic storage nominal, so it cannot distinguish a general nominal-lowering defect from HashMap- and Channel-specific ABIs.
next.entails: Select a real feature-covering workload without benchmark-only APIs or workload shaping; create source-equivalent Able, Go, Python, and Ruby implementations whose hot state naturally lives in an application-defined generic nominal backed by static Arrays; verify strict interpreter-free generation, native fields and aliases, then collect repeated verifier-backed timings and exact allocation profiles.
next.importance: A native result closes the general nominal route and keeps attention on kernel services; a material runtime.Value transition would be the first admissible evidence for a shared compiler representation correction.
